Name: Seasonal Wedding Arch
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
Adds many seasonal flowery wedding arches.

[b]Compatibility:
[/b][list]
[*]Four additional flowers options if you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
[*]The seasonal wedding arch will be use for the Ridgeside wedding reception
[*]Twelve additional flower options if you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]
[*]Eight additional flower options if you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Compatible with Airyn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29885]Custom Wedding Ceremony[/url]﻿ thanks to Airyn!
[*]Works with SVE
[*]Works with recolour mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81588608]Elaho's [/url]custom weddings if you choose the basic wedding﻿
[*]Optionally compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6200]Life Cycle - Rival Heart Events[/url]﻿ (see config option note below)
[/list]
[b]Config Options:[/b]

Spring:[list]
[*]Tulip, Daffodil
[/list]Summer:
[list]
[*]Summer Spangle, Sweet Pea, Sunflower
[/list]Fall:
[list]
[*]Sunflower, Fairy Rose
[/list]Winter:
[list]
[*]Crocus, Holly
[/list]Wood Colour:
[list]
[*]Default, Birch, Walnut, Mahogany, Oak, Dark, Cornucopia-Spring Trellis, Cornucopia-Summer Trellis, Cornucopia-Fall Trellis, Cornucopia-Winter Trellis, Cornucopia-Seasonal Trellis
[/list]The Cornucopia Trellis options are based on the seasonal rose trellises from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]. Selecting the Spring, Summer, Fall, or Winter Trellis option will use that colour scheme regardless of in-game season. Selecting the Seasonal Trellis option will automatically match the colour scheme to the in-game season.

------------------------------------------------------------
If you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Atelier Goods[/url], the following options are also available:

Spring:[list]
[*]Creeping Daisy, Mysteria
[/list]Summer:
[list]
[*]Forest Chamomile, Valerian
[/list]Fall:
[list]
[*]Pie Blossom, Caramel Blossom
[/list]Winter:
[list]
[*]Quartz Primrose, Sugar Blossom
[/list]------------------------------------------------------------
If you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url], the following options are also available:

Spring:[list]
[*]Lilac, Morning Glory, Spring Rose, Prismatic Rose
[/list]Summer:
[list]
[*]Lilac, Hydrangea, Lily, Summer Rose, Prismatic Rose
[/list]Fall:
[list]
[*]Clematis, Dahlia, Fall Rose, Prismatic Rose
[/list]Winter:
[list]
[*]Winter Rose, Prismatic Rose
[/list]------------------------------------------------------------
If you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], the following options are also available:

Spring:[list]
[*]Ridge Azorean
[/list]Summer:
[list]
[*]Mountain Hokkaido
[/list]Fall:
[list]
[*]Summit Snowbell
[/list]Winter:
[list]
[*]Aurorean Iris
[/list]RSV Arch:
[list]
[*]True, False (Whether the arch shown during the Ridgeside Village hotel wedding reception is edited)
[/list]------------------------------------------------------------
If you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29885]Custom Wedding Ceremony[/url], the following options can be configured:

CWC Decor:
[list]
[*]True, False (Whether the misc. wedding decorations in the custom wedding ceremony are edited to match the seasonal wedding arch)
[/list]CWC Rug Colour:
[list]
[*]Green, Beige, White, Original (Recolours the rug in the custom wedding ceremony to better match the seasonal wedding arch)
[/list]------------------------------------------------------------
If you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6200]Life Cycle - Rival Heart Events[/url], the following option can be toggled:

Life Cycle Arch:[list]
[*]True, False (Whether the arch in the rival weddings is edited. False by default, as Lewis slightly clips the seasonal arch during rival weddings because the base is wider.)
[/list]------------------------------------------------------------
If you choose a modded flower option without having the respective mod installed, the arch will fall back to a base game flower instead.

Thank you to Airyn for adding Custom Wedding Ceremony compat, fixing Atelier Goods compat, and generally braving my original content.json that was written in one sitting.
Thank you to Amairylle for suggesting Cornucopia compat, and getting me back into gear updating my mods after a long hiatus.

[b]Troubleshooting:[/b]
If something has gone wrong, I [b]need[/b] a SMAPI log to help you. See smapi.io/log for instructions.
It is not possible to troubleshoot without a log. Thank you for helping me help you!
